انتقضوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَضُوا (intaqaḍū) /in.ta.qa.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
# اِنْتَقِضُوا (intaqiḍū) /in.ta.qi.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
